objective: The selected next step of ONE-BIT-20261108-001 (G1; A25, A35), started on 2026-11-08 at the coordinator's go-ahead: does the last one-bit decorated substitution of the pinwheel, s(0) = 10101, s(1) = 00110 (with its relabelling), force the pinwheel?
